events.description: Monica Geller says Ross Geller, Joey Tribbiani, and Chandler Bing do not understand that for Monica Geller, Phoebe Buffay, and Rachel Green, kissing is as important as any other part of sex.

Chandler Bing says the concert representing sex is over.
